findings.title: Thin content (~441 words)
findings.detail: Enough for a brand page, not enough to compete for head keywords.
findings.fix: Expand the copy, or add supporting pages.

findings.title: Only 2 real internal page link(s)
findings.detail: 1 links are same-page anchors (#rules-section) and 0 are external. This is a one-page site, so it can only rank for one page's worth of keywords.
findings.fix: Build a small content cluster: /how-to-play, /rules, /5-player-ludo, /blog/... Each real page targets one keyword and links to the others. Same-page anchors do not pass any ranking value.

findings.title: No robots.txt in the project
findings.detail: There is no robots.txt to ship, so crawlers get a 404 for it.
findings.fix: Add public/robots.txt with the production sitemap URL, and explicitly allow the AI crawlers you want citations from (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot).

findings.title: No XML sitemap in the project
findings.detail: Nothing tells search engines which URLs exist.
findings.fix: Generate public/sitemap.xml at build time and declare it in robots.txt.

findings.title: Only 0 trust page(s) referenced in the source
findings.detail: Found: none. About, Contact, Privacy and Terms pages are E-E-A-T requirements. Google and AI engines both check whether a site is a real, accountable business before trusting it with commercial keywords.
findings.fix: Create About, Contact, Privacy Policy and Terms pages. For a game site that will handle real users, Terms and Privacy are not optional.
